mapper.sql:
CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, PARTY_TYPE3, PARTY_TYPE2, PARTY_TYPE1, INDUSTRY, INDUSTRY2, INSITITUTE_CODE, IS_GOV, MAIN_CAPITAL, REGISTER_CAPITAL, PROVINCE, CITY, COUNTY, HOLDING_TYPE, CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE, IS_LISTED_COMPANY, IS_GROUP_CUSTOMER, PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, PARENT_CUSTOMER_NAME, IS_PRIVATE, IS_ESCAPE_DEPT, CREDIT_TYPE, IS_CREDIT_RELATED_TRD, STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE, INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE, BUSI_SCOPE, MAIN_BUSI, SEX, PERSON_ID, M_PHONE, PHONE, POSITION, COMPANY_NAME, ADDRESS, MAIL, PROPERTY, LINK_ID1, LINK_ID2, LINK_ID3, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME
,IS_FIN_LICENCE
,INDUSTRY3,INDUSTRY4
mapper.select:
select T1.CUSTOMER_ID, T1.CUSTOMER_NAME, T2.PARTY_TYPE3, T2.PARTY_TYPE2, T2.PARTY_TYPE1, T2.INDUSTRY, T2.INDUSTRY2, T2.INSITITUTE_CODE, T2.IS_GOV, T2.MAIN_CAPITAL, T2.REGISTER_CAPITAL, T2.PROVINCE, T2.CITY, T2.COUNTY, T2.HOLDING_TYPE, T2.CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE, T2.IS_LISTED_COMPANY, T2.IS_GROUP_CUSTOMER, T2.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, T2.PARENT_CUSTOMER_NAME, T2.IS_PRIVATE, T2.IS_ESCAPE_DEPT, T2.CREDIT_TYPE, T2.IS_CREDIT_RELATED_TRD, T2.STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE, T2.INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE, T2.BUSI_SCOPE, MAIN_BUSI, T2.SEX, T2.PERSON_ID, T2.M_PHONE, T2.PHONE, T2.POSITION, T2.COMPANY_NAME, T2.ADDRESS, T2.MAIL, T2.PROPERTY, T2.LINK_ID1, T2.LINK_ID2, T2.LINK_ID3, T2.REMARK, T2.CREATE_USER, T2.CREATE_DEPT, T2.CREATE_TIME, T2.UPDATE_USER, T2.UPDATE_TIME
,T2.IS_FIN_LICENCE, T2.INDUSTRY3, T2.INDUSTRY4
from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T1 full outer join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD T2 on T1.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.CUSTOMER_ID
AND T1.CUSTOMER_ID like concat('%',concat(#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND T1.CUSTOMER_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{customerName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND T1.CUSTOMER_TYPE = #{customerType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T2.IS_FIN_LICENCE = #{isFinLicence,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T2.IS_FIN_LICENCE is null
order by CUSTOMER_ID desc

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID code, CUSTOMER_ID name, CUSTOMER_NAME shortName, CUSTOMER_ID hidCode FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where CUSTOMER_ID like concat('%',concat(#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) AND CUSTOMER_TYPE = #{customerType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID code, CUSTOMER_NAME name, CUSTOMER_NAME shortName, CUSTOMER_NAME hidCode FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO
AND CUSTOMER_ID like concat('%',concat(#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND CUSTOMER_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{customerName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND CUSTOMER_TYPE = #{customerType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select T1.CUSTOMER_ID, T1.CUSTOMER_NAME, T2.PARTY_TYPE3, T2.PARTY_TYPE2, T2.PARTY_TYPE1, T2.INDUSTRY, T2.INDUSTRY2, T2.INSITITUTE_CODE, T2.IS_GOV, T2.MAIN_CAPITAL, T2.REGISTER_CAPITAL, T2.PROVINCE, T2.CITY, T2.COUNTY, T2.HOLDING_TYPE, T2.CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE, T2.IS_LISTED_COMPANY, T2.IS_GROUP_CUSTOMER, T2.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, T2.PARENT_CUSTOMER_NAME, T2.IS_PRIVATE, T2.IS_ESCAPE_DEPT, T2.CREDIT_TYPE, T2.IS_CREDIT_RELATED_TRD, T2.STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE, T2.INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE, T2.BUSI_SCOPE, MAIN_BUSI, T2.SEX, T2.PERSON_ID, T2.M_PHONE, T2.PHONE, T2.POSITION, T2.COMPANY_NAME, T2.ADDRESS, T2.MAIL, T2.PROPERTY, T2.LINK_ID1, T2.LINK_ID2, T2.LINK_ID3, T2.REMARK, T2.CREATE_USER, T2.CREATE_DEPT, T2.CREATE_TIME, T2.UPDATE_USER, T2.UPDATE_TIME,T2.HS_TYPE
,T2.IS_FIN_LICENCE
,T2.INDUSTRY3 ,T2.INDUSTRY4
from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T1 inner join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD T2 on T1.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.CUSTOMER_ID where T1.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select sum(count) from ( select count(*) count from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T1,MST_COUNTER_PARTY T2 where T1.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.LINK_ID and T1.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all select count(*) count from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T3,FIN_PRODUCT T4 where (T3.CUSTOMER_ID=T4.ISSUER or T3.CUSTOMER_ID=T4.SPONSOR) and T3.CUSTOMER_ID= #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all select count(*) count from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T5,FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T6 where T5.CUSTOMER_ID = T6.UNDER_WRITER_ID and T5.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select * from ( select T1.CUSTOMER_ID from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T1,MST_COUNTER_PARTY T2 where T1.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.LINK_ID union all select T3.CUSTOMER_ID from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T3,FIN_PRODUCT T4 where (T3.CUSTOMER_ID=T4.ISSUER or T3.CUSTOMER_ID=T4.SPONSOR) ) T where T.CUSTOMER_ID in
#{item.customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT O_CODE as oCode, NOTICE_DATE as noticeDate, GRADE_DATE as gradeDate, SHORT_LONG_TERM as shortLongTerm, GRADE_RESULT as gradeResult, GRADE_EXPECTATION as gradeExpectation, DIRECTION_CHANGE as directionChange, GRADE_ORG_ID as gradeOrgId FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING WHERE O_CODE = #{customerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT O_CODE as oCode, NOTICE_DATE as noticeDate, GRADE_DATE as gradeDate, SHORT_LONG_TERM as shortLongTerm, GRADE_RESULT as gradeResult, GRADE_EXPECTATION as gradeExpectation, DIRECTION_CHANGE as directionChange, GRADE_ORG_ID as gradeOrgId FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING WHERE O_CODE = #{customerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select sdl1.ITEM_CODE id,sdl1.ITEM_VALUE text from SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl1 inner join SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK sdll on sdll.LINKED_DICT_CODE = #{dict_code_parent} and sdl1.ITEM_CODE=sdll.ITEM_CODE and sdll.DICT_CODE=sdl1.DICT_CODE
and TRIM(sdll.LINKED_ITEM_CODE) = TRIM(#{item_code_child})
sdl1.ITEM_VALUE like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
select CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where CUSTOMER_NAME = #{customerName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and CUSTOMER_TYPE = #{customerType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select CUSTOMER_ID, INSTITUTION_NAME, PARTY_TYPE3, REP_INDUSTRY, REP_INDUSTRY_LEVEL2, PARTY_TYPE2, PARTY_TYPE1, IS_TOP_COMPANY, INSTITUTION_CODE, IS_GOV, BECIF, PROVINCE, CITY, COUNTY, HOLDING_TYPE, CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE, IS_LISTED_COMPANY, IS_GROUP_CUSTOMER, PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID, PARENT_CUSTOMER_NAME, IS_PRIVATE, IS_ESCAPE_DEPT, CREDIT_TYPE, IS_CREDIT_RELATED_TRD, STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE, INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE, BUSI_SCOPE, MAIN_BUSI, CUSTOMER_LEVEL, REGIST_CAPITAL, ACTUAL_CAPITAL from INTERF_CMS_INSTITUTION where BECIF = #{becif}

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,CUSTOMER_NAME FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where (IS_ISSUER is not null or IS_ASSTE_MANAGER is not null or IS_TRUSTER is not null or IS_FINANCIER is not null or IS_GUARANTEE is not null or IS_PLEDGOR is not null or IS_SALER is not null or IS_DEPOSIT_BANK is not null or IS_INVEST_ADVISER is not null) and CUSTOMER_ID in
#{item.customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select * from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD where (INSITITUTE_CODE=#{insitituteCode} or CUSTOMER_ID=#{insitituteCode}) and ROWNUM=1

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID as customerId, CUSTOMER_NAME as customerName, PARTY_TYPE3 as partyType3, PARTY_TYPE2 as partyType2, PARTY_TYPE1 as partyType1 , INDUSTRY as industry, INDUSTRY2 as industry2, INSITITUTE_CODE as insitituteCode, IS_GOV as isGov, MAIN_CAPITAL as mainCapital, REGISTER_CAPITAL as registerCapital, PROVINCE as province, CITY as city, COUNTY as county, HOLDING_TYPE as holdingType, CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE as customerObjType, IS_LISTED_COMPANY as isListedCompany, IS_GROUP_CUSTOMER as isGroupCustomer, PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID as parentCustomerId, PARENT_CUSTOMER_NAME as parentCustomerName, IS_PRIVATE as isPrivate, IS_ESCAPE_DEPT as isEscapeDept, CREDIT_TYPE as creditType , IS_CREDIT_RELATED_TRD as isCreditRelatedTrd, STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE as structAdjustType, INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE as indusUpgrateType, BUSI_SCOPE as busiScope, MAIN_BUSI as mainBusi, COMPANY_NATURE as companyNature, REMARK as remark, HS_TYPE as hsType FROM INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO where (INSITITUTE_CODE=#{insitituteCode} or CUSTOMER_ID=#{insitituteCode}) and ROWNUM=1
